summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend regression suite 24/24 PASS (no changes since iter 1). Frontend: all newly added features verified — Hero3D CSS hero on Main Menu, SoundToggle (Volume2/VolumeX swap + localStorage 'strayz_sound' = on/off persistence), 4 unique DiceBear avatars for chris/archie/lynn/deb, Block Break CTA on Main Menu, /tetris page with board+panel+next-preview+controls (left/right/rotate buttons all visually move the piece), /play/1 -> dismiss intro -> HotspotScene with all 6 hotspots, current hotspot pulses, clicking h1 opens puzzle-card and back-to-scene-button returns to hotspot view. Web Audio SFX plays without console errors; Howler music gracefully fails silently (no crash even though Mixkit MP3s 403). Companion mood + speech bubble reactive on wrong answer ('OOPS'). play-tetris-interlude button verified in source code (GamePlay.jsx line 543) and route /tetris confirmed working independently.
critical_code_review_comments: Howler is dynamically imported in /app/frontend/src/lib/sound.js — onloaderror/onplayerror fall through gracefully; verified no crash. Good.
TetrisMini uses setPiece inside a setInterval-driven callback; piece-locking and clearing logic correctly handle stacking. No memory leaks observed during testing.
HotspotScene relies on `LEVEL_HOTSPOTS[levelId]` from /app/frontend/src/data/hotspots.js — all 6 hotspots for level 1 render at expected positions and pulse only for currentIdx.
Same deprecation note carried from iteration 1: server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') (deprecated in newer FastAPI). Low priority.
_PUZZLE_CACHE in backend still grows unbounded with AI-generated riddles. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Reused TEST_player_<uuid> fixture; cleaned via pymongo delete_many({player_id: /^TEST_/}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-2 features all verified.
